top_band: light green top-lit canopy crown and upper surfaces of leaf clusters (rows 1-30)
evidence: The tree has top-lit spherical leaf clusters forming an overarching canopy (rows 1-54) with deep underside shadows and a vertical brown trunk emerging from underneath (rows 47-78). Look at the base however: row 78 is a completely flat horizontal line, though the canopy itself is rendered in 3/4 view.

style.evidence: Compared to the Beodeul reference trees, the candidate has a rigid, artificial structure: the canopy is made of uniform round 'broccoli' spheres rather than irregular organic leaf clusters with visible interior branches, and the trunk is a straight cylinder ending in a completely flat horizontal base line (row 78) instead of organic spreading roots.
